_meta.notes: User overrides: ~/.kollab/models.json (merged on top). Lookup is longest-prefix match on the model string, so keep an explicit entry for every point release whose window differs from its family (e.g. grok-4.5 vs grok-4). supports_sampling=false means the model rejects temperature/top_p/top_k with a 400 -- providers omit them; absent means allowed. supports_vision=true/false declares whether the model accepts image input; unknown models are treated as unsupported.

gpt-5.6.notes: Alias for gpt-5.6-sol. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output for the whole request.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: Frontier tier. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output.

gpt-5.6-terra.notes: Balanced tier. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output.

gpt-6-astra.notes: Frontier tier. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output.

gpt-6.1-sol.notes: Update to GPT-6 Sol, ChatGPT Work/Codex first. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output.

gpt-6-sol.notes: Coding/agentic tier. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output.

gpt-6-luna.notes: Cost tier. Knowledge cutoff 2026-05-18. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output. Batch/Flex 50% off.

gpt-5.6-luna.notes: Cost tier. Requests over 272K input tokens bill 2x input / 1.5x output.

claude-fable-5-1.notes: Frontier Anthropic model for long-running agents. Sampling/thinking behavior assumed to match claude-fable-5 -- re-verify.

claude-opus-5-5.notes: Matches Fable 5.1 on most work at ~40% less than Opus 5. Sampling behavior assumed to match claude-opus-5 -- re-verify.

claude-sonnet-5-5.notes: Latest Sonnet. Cached rate assumed 10% of input; sampling behavior assumed to match claude-sonnet-5 -- re-verify.

claude-fable-5.notes: Most capable Anthropic model. Thinking is always on -- sending any thinking config (including disabled) is a 400. No assistant prefill. Requires 30-day data retention (unavailable under ZDR).

claude-mythos-5.notes: Same specs and API behavior as claude-fable-5. Access limited to Project Glasswing.

claude-opus-5.notes: Current Opus flagship. Thinking is on by default (omitting it runs adaptive); disabling thinking is only valid at effort high or below. Separate rate-limit bucket from Opus 4.x.

claude-opus-4-7.notes: Adaptive thinking only; sampling params (temperature/top_p/top_k) and budget_tokens are rejected.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: Introductory pricing of 2.00/10.00 applies through 2026-08-31. Rejects non-default temperature/top_p/top_k, so they are omitted entirely. New tokenizer: same text is ~30% more tokens than Sonnet 4.6.

gemini-3.8-flash.notes: Promo rate through 2026-12-31, prices rise 2027-01-01. Context/output limits copied from sibling Flash entries (not stated on the models page); cached rate not published there.

gemini-3.7-flash.notes: Promo rate through 2026-12-31. Context/output limits copied from sibling Flash entries (not stated on the models page); cached rate not published there.

gemini-3.1-pro.notes: Served as gemini-3.1-pro-preview. default maxOutputTokens is 8192, must set explicitly for 65K. Prompts over 200K bill at 4.00/18.00.

gemini-3-flash.notes: Served as gemini-3-flash-preview. Audio input bills at 1.00.

glm-5.2.notes: 1M context / 128K output. Coding Plan quota multiplies 3x during 14:00-18:00 UTC+8.

glm-4.7.notes: z.ai GLM-4.7: 200K context / 128K output. Also served via anthropic-compatible endpoint (api.z.ai/api/anthropic). Pricing approximate.

grok-4.7.notes: Latest Grok. Prompts over 200K bill at 4.00/12.00 (cached 1.00); output limit not documented.

grok-4.6.notes: 1.5T-parameter base. Prompts over 200K bill at 4.00/12.00 (cached 1.00); output limit not documented.

grok-4.5.notes: Frontier reasoning tier. Prompts over 200K bill at 4.00/12.00; output limit not documented.

grok-4.20.notes: Covers grok-4.20-0309-reasoning / -non-reasoning / -multi-agent-0309. Prompts over 200K bill at 2.50/5.00.

grok-4.notes: No longer listed on docs.x.ai as of 2026-07-29 -- superseded by grok-4.3 / grok-4.5. Kept so existing profiles keep resolving a real window.

llama-4-maverick.notes: open-weight, on-demand capped 4K output, dedicated uncapped

deepseek-v4-pro.notes: 1M context is the floor for all V4 calls, not a premium tier. pricing_in is the cache-miss rate.

mistral-small-4.notes: 119B MoE, 6.5B active. Hybrid reasoning + image understanding.
